intent: Audit and repair all 24 November 6 diagnostic findings: evidence-backed GitHub completion and safe continuation, complete bounded diagnostic capture, context reuse, protocol-aware MCP discovery and efficient chat rendering.

acceptance.completion: Tool receipts alone never establish task success; missing verification or cleanup remains visible and resumable without repeating uncertain writes.
acceptance.budgets: Reserve verification within the user's accepted budget; never silently increase authorized tool calls.
acceptance.evidence: Export retained evidence in bounded pages/chunks, with integrity, consistent boundaries and explicit missing ranges.
acceptance.privacy: Preserve local-only context protections and selected-profile enforcement.
acceptance.qualification: Physical device jank, original private MCP endpoints and provider usage availability require their real environments.
